text_block_list.text:
The day before the Spring Fan Thanksgiving 
Festival.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um, alright then... Decoration team! We're 
heading to the next spot, so follow me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wait... Huh, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What, are you bored? Are you doing your 
job properly? ...Slacking off is fine and 
all, but keep it in moderation.
choice_data_list: Haha... You're really fired up, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Did you come by to check on me? ...Hehe, 
thank you.
choice_data_list: Haha... You're really fired up, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I asked, and they're letting me help 
out the Student Council for this Fan 
Appreciation Day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You know how Air Groove-senpai is amazing 
as the Student Council Vice President too, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So I thought if I got closer to her in 
ways like this... maybe I could figure out 
how to be more like Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, this is no time to be chatting! 
Well, I've got work to do, so see ya.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wait, sorry, I've gotta run! I still have 
so much to do. The student council sure 
keeps you busy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...If you're going to skip, you'd better 
properly come skip out on the day of the 
event too!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
See you later then, Trainer. ...Oh, and I 
made sure to clear my schedule for that 
day, okay!

And so, looking like a true "Empress," I 
watched Mejiro Dober's back as she led her 
juniors away...

And so, looking like a true "Empress," I 
watched Mejiro Dober's back as she led her 
juniors away...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well now, versatile on all fronts! That's 
some truly magnificent work, Mejiro Dober.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However—hmm. You don't look all that 
triumphant, do you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry to have made you worry about 
me. As expected, nothing escapes the 
President's notice."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However, I have no words to impart. 
Nothing from me to Mejiro Dober, that is.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes. I understand—

And the next day. The day of the Fan 
Thanksgiving Festival finally arrived, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: NOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And so! Dober has come down with a fever!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay? Understand? —Alright, let's go! 
Go, go, gooo~!!

Against an Umamusume's strength... 
especially Taiki Shuttle, who was renowned 
for her power, struggling was utterly 
futile.

And so, in the blink of an eye, we ended 
up arriving at—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Dober! Taiki's Special Express 
Get-Well Delivery is heeeeere!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Taiki, you're whispering, yet somehow 
still so loud... It's pounding in my head, 
so please, not right now—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wait, Trainer?! Uh, why are you here...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Taiki...! Don't tell me you brought 
it here?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Non-non! To be precise, I carried him here 
on my shoulders!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's the exact same thing!! Ugh... ow, my 
head hurts...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What's going on? So noisy. Dober should 
just be sleeping, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...! W-What do we do, the dorm head is...! 
Trainers aren't allowed in the Umamusume 
dorms!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No problem! Leave it to me! I have a plan!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey, big sis Umamusume~!! Welcooome—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Something super dangerous and so bad! I'm 
gooooiiing to go do it right now!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh!? As if that's a valid declaration!! 
Hold it right there, Taikiiiiii!!

And so, thanks to Taiki Shuttle's quick 
thinking(?), we managed to get by without 
getting caught.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Well, um. The student council is a lot 
busier than I thought—
choice_data_list: Did overexertion finally take its toll?
Did you push yourself too hard?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like it. I'm so pathetic...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I knew it... I've still got a long way to 
go before I can be like Air 
Groove-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...No, wait. Um—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's entirely my own fault anyway, so no 
need for get-well visits or anything. 
...Go enjoy the Thanksgiving Festival.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I brought this completely upon myself, 
so... you don't need to visit me anymore. 
Trainer, just go enjoy the Fan 
Thanksgiving Festival, okay?"

Though she said that, the fever must make 
her feel vulnerable, as Mejiro Dober 
looked somewhat lonely.

Though she said that, the fever must make 
her feel vulnerable, as Mejiro Dober 
looked somewhat lonely.

"Normally this area is off-limits, so we 
shouldn't linger for long, but at least—"
choice_data_list: Is there anything you'd like me to do?
Is there anything you'd like me to do?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh, what do you mean, "something"...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ............Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's not it!! ...Ugh, what is wrong 
with me? Is it the fever...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ............Are you really sure it's okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...W-Well then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "That... apple over there. Peel it."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Your hand. Could you... place it on my 
forehead?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Did I ever tell you? ...I like fruit. 
...That's why.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
When I had a fever as a child, Ryan did 
that for me... and it helped me sleep so 
well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Please.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Please.

And so, listening to the distant hustle 
and bustle of the Thanksgiving festival, I 
peeled an apple for Mejiro Dober...

And so, listening to the distant hustle 
and bustle of the Thanksgiving festival, I 
placed a hand on Mejiro Dober's 
forehead...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What is this... a monster? ...Wait, a 
rabbit?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...My Trainer's hand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So you actually tried your best? Hehe, 
dummy. ...Mmm, it's delicious.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Such a comforting warmth, isn't it—

I spent a brief moment together with 
Mejiro Dober—
And then, the next morning.

...After that, I stayed by her side until 
she fell asleep, then quietly left the 
dormitory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Dober, how are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Dober, did you sleep well? I brought you 
some souvenirs!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: A souvenir...? Ryan, what's that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, well you see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Every single one of these fan 
letters was collected for you at the Fan 
Appreciation Festival, Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So many... warm words...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Everyone is cheering for 
you, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Not just... feedback on the race. They 
say they draw strength from my words and 
attitude... I don't really get it myself, 
but...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. ...Guess I'd better get this treated 
quickly, right?
And then, the next morning.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Dober! ...Is your fever completely gone?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Senpai! Yes, I'm completely 
recovered...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm really sorry about yesterday! 
Even though I said I'd help out, I ended 
up being of no use at all when the time 
came.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Still... I've fired myself right back up! 
I'm gonna keep giving it my all!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So that I can become like Air 
Groove-senpai—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You are already in the Senior Class. You 
stand on the same stage as me, vying for 
supremacy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why... listen closely. 
This is—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
These are my final words to you, as one 
who walked this path before you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ――Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober. What you desire, the future 
you strive for, that glory... You will 
never reach it as you are now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Those belong to none other than—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Because if I'm not "Mejiro Dober," it's 
something I'll never be able to attain.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hu... h, S-Senior... What do you mean by 
that...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I told you those were my final words. 
The rest is for you to discover yourself."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Well then—pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah... Wait! Please wait, Senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove... Senpai...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "...Dober. My beloved, proud junior."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ideals exist solely to be surpassed one 
day.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Someday, clear the clouds with your own 
hands and become the light.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for that moment all this 
time.
